hypothesis: The prior four-arm 20-step screen showed a pooled 1.76868% lower mean for interleaved preparation, but its two adjacent contrasts had opposite signs. Repeating the same preparation-only treatment in a reverse B-A-A-B order over 40 solver steps per arm will test whether the pooled direction persists over a longer horizon while balancing linear order drift.

mechanism_evidence.observation: Each inherited-preparation arm showed approximately +9.78 GiB FilePages on node 1 and +0 on node 0; each interleaved-preparation arm showed approximately +4.89 GiB on each node.
mechanism_evidence.limit: Cumulative node-wide counters are not process-attributed page placement and do not establish a solver-performance effect.

control: Same accepted Scotch source, runtime, solver launch, physics, 40-step horizon, sampler, and inherited launcher-parent policy in all arms.
treatment: Copy/hash child inherited policy versus child-only numactl --interleave=all.
